zones.title: Receive
zones.body: One turn per call: sessionId, transcript, ASR confidence.

zones.title: Load state
zones.body: Prompts (goals, rules, spoken lines), the session row and the market row are the only state the model sees.

zones.title: Gates and prompt
zones.body: YesNoGate: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY, CONSENT and DEALER moves the state before the model runs, so a small model cannot loop on a confirmed question. The system prompt is rebuilt every turn from ar_prompts and the facts.

zones.title: Reason
zones.body: The agent has three tools, Postgres memory and a structured parser with auto-fix.

zones.title: Guards 1: gates
zones.body: The model's output is clamped to the allowed values, then each rule is an If (the condition) and an Edit Fields (what it changes). Gates: a deterministic yes or no in IDENTIFY and CONSENT wins over the model.

zones.title: Guards 2: caller and booking
zones.body: Caller asks for a person: handoff. A booking claim without a confirmation code is replaced by a question. A booking made by a tool forces BOOKED.

zones.title: Guards 3: reply and end
zones.body: Empty or over-long replies are fixed. A handoff always speaks the market's handover line. No end before BOOKED or WRAPUP.

zones.title: Handoff
zones.body: A model failure answers with a fixed apology and PLATFORM_ERROR. Any handoff builds the Refer-To through AR-14.

zones.title: Respond
zones.body: Session update, event row, the reply the gateway speaks.

panels.title: AR-02 Dialogue turn
panels.body: The brain. State lives in ar_sessions; the system prompt is rebuilt every turn. Guards after the model: no booking claim without a confirmation code, no slot that was not offered, no end before WRAPUP.

panels.title: Tools
panels.body: FindDealers, FindSlots, BookAppointment. sessionId is plumbed, never a model parameter. Handoff is not a tool: it is a deterministic consequence of action=handoff.
